content:
Overview

Khor Fakkan is a city in Sharjah with a population of 48,000. Sharjah’s east coast enclave on the Gulf of Oman, a picturesque port city surrounded by the Hajar Mountains with excellent diving spots. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 340 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
